uncertain: Dashed markers 2, 3 and 4 are shared-area search markers for the rare encounters, not three fixed or guaranteed spawn points. The full set of Vanilla spawn positions in the graveyard and tomb approach is not verified.
The dashed upper-crypt outline and internal obstructions represent the documented chamber arrangement schematically; exact stair turns, door openings and vertical alignment require verification.
notes: The regular encounter order is Interrogator Vishas followed by Bloodmage Thalnos. Rare encounters may occur between them; their numbering does not imply a fixed order among the rares.
Q1 is the Horde quest giver in the Chamber of Atonement.
The open graveyard is walkable on both sides of the central path; its path edges are not walls.
Hearts of Zeal uses distributed Scarlet Crusade creature drops; no fixed pickup is asserted.
Scorn, associated with the Scourge Invasion event, is not included in this baseline non-event sheet.
There is no internal player teleporter. Panels separate the surface and the two crypt levels; distances are not to scale.
